title: Playboy: X Mates Volume 1 - BMX & Wakeboards
original_title: Playboy: X Mates Volume 1 - BMX & Wakeboards
overview: Wearing little more than a helmet, a stunning cast of Playmates take on today's hottest extreme sports! You've never seen them so daring as they gear up and strip down to bust out the ultimate tricks on land and water. First these all-terrain hotties rev your engines to tackle the world of BMX racing with 20-inch bikes, a 20-foot ramp, and a foam landing pit -- completely naked! Then they take the wakeboarding world by storm with X Games medalist Parks Bonifay, who really flips when he sees these gorgeous rad riders wearing little more than their tan lines. Hang on as Playboy delivers the sexiest in-your-face action the world of extreme sports has ever seen!
